name: Geometric Buffers (G-buffers)
definition: A mechanism for Non-Photorealistic Rendering (NPR) using two-dimensional intermediate images that encapsulate a single geometric property (e.g., depth, normal) of the visible object at each pixel, enabling 2D image processing for line generation.
summary: Geometric Buffers decouple geometric analysis from shading by storing per-pixel properties in 2D images, enabling efficient, interactive non-photorealistic volume rendering via fast 2D processing.
